type.title: Event type
type.description: The Podio hook event, for example item.create, item.update, item.delete or hook.verify

hook_id.title: hook_id
hook_id.description: The Podio hook that sent the delivery; needed for a hook validation

code.title: Hooks verification code
code.description: Present only on a hook validation (hook.verify)

item_id.title: Item ID
item_id.description: The item the delivery names; read with GET /item/{item_id} unless the event is item.delete
